title: De bloemenvelden

The text covers both practical instructions and historical background, encouraging a hands-on approach to growing and understanding ornamental plants—primarily hyacinths, tulips, and narcissi. He recounts childhood and educational experiences, praises local teachers, and emphasizes the traditions and expertise of the region’s growers.
